'''''Rainbow Berry Bush''''' was an abstract painting made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was one of two paintings made by [[Klepa Laeel]] that were put on display at the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]]. It depicted, as its name suggested, a [[rainbow berry bush]].
